newsitem.title: USA: ONYX Acceptance files for pass-thru certs.
newsitem.headline: ONYX Acceptance files for pass-thru certs.

text.p: ONYX Acceptance Corp said Friday it filed a registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 million in auto loan pass-through certificates, series 1996-4.
The offering in the Irvine, Calif., company will be made through Merrill Lynch and Co, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be used to repay loans incurred pursuant to its short-term funding program with respect to the initial contracts or to fund the pre-funded amount to permit the purchase of additional motor vehicle contracts during the funding period, the company said.
